content: Hahoi Job ni a pathung teh.

content.text: Sahnin hai ka phuenangnae a patawpoung.
Ka kâhram lawi vah ka kut ni thayung awm hoeh toe.
Oe, ama teh nâ lah maw ao tie hah ka panue vaiteh,
a tahungnae koe ka phat haw pawiteh.
A hmalah ka kong heh ka phakhai vaiteh,
ka pahni teh na lawkpanuesaknae hoi a kawi han ei.
Na pathungnae lawk hah ka panue vaiteh,
kai koe a dei hane hah ka thaipanuek han ei.
Ka lentoe e hnotithainae hoi na taran han namaw
Na taran mahoeh, ka kong hah hoe na pouk pouh han doeh.
Hawvah ama hoi tamikalan ni pouk thai awh vaiteh,
lawkcengkungnaw koehoi yungyoe ka hlout han toe.
Khenhaw! hmalah ka cei, hateiteh ama la awm hoeh.
Hnuklah bout ka ban eiteh, ama teh ka hmawt thai hoeh.
Avoilae kut hoi a tawk navah ama teh ka khen thai hoeh.
Aranglae kut dawk a kamlang toteh ama hah ka hmawt thai hoeh.
Hateiteh, ka dawn e lamthung hah ama ni a panue.
Na tanouk toteh sui patetlah ka tâco han.
A khok dawk ka khok ni kacakcalah a kamtung teh,
a lamthung hah phen laipalah ka dawn.
A pahni dawk hoi kâpoelawk hah ka cettakhai hoeh.
A pahni dawk hoi ka tâcawt e lawk hah
ka panki e rawca hlak hai ka pâtung.
Hateiteh, ama teh buet touh lah ao dawkvah,
apinimaw a dum thai han.
A hringnae ni a sak han a ngai e pueng hah a sak.
Kai hanelah a pouk e hah a sak.
Ama dawk hot patet e hah moikapap ao.
Hatdawkvah, a hmalah o e hah ka taki.
Hetheh ka pouk navah ama ka taki.
Cathut ni ka lung a pout sak teh,
Athakasaipounge hah na taki sak.
Hatei, hmonae dawk hoi na kapek hoeh teh,
ka hma lae hmonae kadung poung e dawk na ramuk hoeh.
